name: PAN-OS Repeated Sensitive-Service Access
description: Detects one internal source contacting at least 10 distinct internal destinations on sensitive service ports 22, 23, 135, 139, 445, 3389, 5985, or 5986 within the rule window. This may indicate service discovery or remote-service probing, but it does not prove a successful login or compromise.
note:
## Investigation

Review the source system, destination systems, ports, time window, connection results, and related alerts. Confirm whether the source is an approved vulnerability scanner, monitoring system, administrator workstation, or management tool. Check authentication logs and the destination owners to determine whether any access succeeded.

## Response

Confirm whether the activity was authorised. If it is unexplained or unauthorised, preserve the relevant logs and escalate to the SOC and system owners. Do not automatically block, isolate, reset passwords, or disable accounts based on this alert alone.
author: SecurityOnion
query: event.dataset:"panw.panos" and panw.panos.type:"TRAFFIC" and panw.panos.action:allow and event.action:flow_started and destination.port:(22 or 23 or 135 or 139 or 445 or 3389 or 5985 or 5986) and source.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 or 172.16.0.0/12 or 192.168.0.0/16)
